title.en: ABANDON · 放弃 · 放到一旁 → 旁
title.zh-Hans: ABANDON · 放弃 · 放到一旁 → 旁

gloss.en: give up; leave or withdraw support, depending on context
gloss.zh-Hans: 放弃／抛弃／离弃；依语境亦译遗弃

meaning.en: Standard Translation: abandon → 放弃 / 抛弃 / 离弃 (Supported). Active Association: 放到一旁 → 旁 páng (Author-proposed; Historical Relation: Not claimed). Related ban ↔ 甭 and banal ↔ 般/一般 are separate Phonetic-Semantic Candidates; donner ↔ 捅 is weak. Rejected status belongs only to a + ban + donner as historical segmentation. See the related cards and full ABANDON page.
meaning.zh-Hans: 标准翻译：abandon → 放弃／抛弃／离弃（Supported）。主动联系：放到一旁 → 旁 páng（Author-proposed；Historical Relation: Not claimed）。相关 ban ↔ 甭 与 banal ↔ 般/一般 是独立音义候选；donner ↔ 捅 为弱联想。Rejected 仅适用于 a + ban + donner 历史拆词。见相关卡片与完整 ABANDON 页面。

summary.en: Middle English abandounen (English verb attested in the 14th century) was borrowed from Anglo-French abanduner, derived from abandun and a bandun, referring to power or disposal. Continental Old French à bandon likewise concerns disposal; abandonner is derived from abandon (CNRTL records releasing a rein around 1100 and leaving entirely from the 12th century). This supports the development toward relinquish/give up. It is not historically ban + donner. Bandon belongs to a Germanic command/jurisdiction background; this is not the author’s modern segmentation.
summary.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abandounen（英语动词见于14世纪）借自盎格鲁法语 abanduner，后者由 abandun 及 a bandun 发展，涉及支配与处置。欧洲大陆古法语 à bandon 同样涉及任其处置；abandonner 派生自 abandon（CNRTL 记约1100年的松开缰绳义及12世纪起的完全离开义）。这支持向 relinquish/give up 的语义发展。历史上不是 ban + donner。bandon 具有日耳曼语命令／管辖词族背景，但不是作者提出的现代拆分。

Continental Old French à bandon likewise concerns disposal; abandonner is derived from abandon (CNRTL records releasing a rein around 1100 and leaving entirely from the 12th century). This supports the development toward relinquish/give up. It is not historically ban + donner. Bandon belongs to a Germanic command/jurisdiction background; this is not the author’s modern segmentation.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abandounen（英语动词见于14世纪）借自盎格鲁法语 abanduner，后者由 abandun 及 a bandun 发展，涉及支配与处置。欧洲大陆古法语 à bandon 同样涉及任其处置；abandonner 派生自 abandon（CNRTL 记约1100年的松开缰绳义及12世纪起的完全离开义）。这支持向 relinquish/give up 的语义发展。历史上不是 ban + donner。bandon 具有日耳曼语命令／管辖词族背景，但不是作者提出的现代拆分。

claim.en: English ban (verb) continues Old English bannan, a Germanic proclamation/command verb; Middle English prohibitive senses reflect Norse influence, with later French/Latin influence. The English noun partly derives from the verb and partly from Anglo-French. French ban /bɑ̃/ is a masculine noun of Old Low Franconian origin: public proclamation, feudal summons/jurisdiction, banns, and exclusion in expressions such as mettre au ban. It is not the ordinary French verb “to prohibit” (interdire); the old note’s French ban v. 禁止 is corrected. This distinction does not cancel the independently proposed English ban ↔ 甭 candidate.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语动词 ban 承自古英语 bannan，属于日耳曼语宣告／命令词族；中古英语禁止等义受古诺斯语影响，后又受法语／拉丁语影响。英语名词部分来自动词，部分借自盎格鲁法语。法语 ban /bɑ̃/ 为阳性名词，源于古低地法兰克语，涉及公告、封建征召／管辖、婚姻公告及 mettre au ban 等排斥用语；它不是通常表示“禁止”的法语动词（interdire）。旧笔记“法语 ban v. 禁止”已纠正，这不取消独立的英语 ban ↔ 甭 候选。

claim.en: English banal is borrowed from French (Merriam-Webster: first known English use 1825). CNRTL traces French banal to feudal ban plus -al, with bannel attested in 1247 and the very common/unoriginal sense in 1798. Merriam-Webster describes a Medieval Latin bannalis route for Old French bannel. Both accounts connect seigneurial jurisdiction and shared-use facilities with the later commonplace sense. Neither derives it from Chinese. Ban and banal are separately evaluated observations, but their related European histories must be deduplicated in any family-based experiment.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 banal 借自法语（Merriam-Webster 记英语首见1825年）。CNRTL 将法语 banal 分析为封建法 ban 加 -al，记1247年 bannel 及1798年的极普通／无新意义；Merriam-Webster 则通过中古拉丁语 bannalis 解释古法语 bannel。两者均联系领主管辖、共同使用设施与后来的平常义，不从汉语倒推词史。ban 和 banal 的观察独立评价，但欧洲词史相关，实验按词源家族去重。

summary.en: Two related candidates are evaluated independently; neither maps abandon to 甭. Semantic strength is moderate, overall phonetic-semantic confidence Low.
summary.zh-Hans: 两个相关候选独立评价；均不把 abandon 对应为甭。语义强度 moderate，整体音义置信度 Low。

claim.en: English ban ↔ 甭 béng: Phonetic-Semantic Candidate; semantic strength moderate; overall confidence Low; Historical Relation: Not claimed. The overlap is contextual DON’T / DO NOT / PROHIBIT. English ban often means formal prohibition; 甭 commonly means no need/do not and need not prohibit. English /bæn/ and béng show an author-observed labial onset and loose rhyme resemblance, not homophony: Pinyin b is unaspirated /p/, English b is /b/, final /n/ versus /ŋ/, vowels and tone differ.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 ban ↔ 甭 béng：Phonetic-Semantic Candidate；语义强度 moderate，整体置信度 Low；Historical Relation: Not claimed。交点限于语境中的 DON’T / DO NOT / PROHIBIT。ban 常表正式禁止，“甭”常表不用／不必／不要，不总是禁止。/bæn/ 与 béng 的双唇起音及宽泛韵部近似仅为作者观察，并非同音：拼音 b 为不送气 /p/，英语 b 为 /b/，韵尾 /n/ 与 /ŋ/、元音和声调有别。

claim.en: banal ↔ 般 bān / 一般: Phonetic-Semantic Candidate; semantic strength moderate; overall confidence Low; Historical Relation: Not claimed. The semantic anchor is the word 一般 in its ordinary/common sense, not an assertion that isolated 般 always means ordinary. Modern banal often adds a negative sense of unoriginal or trite that 一般 need not carry. French /ba.nal/ permits a partial ban- versus bān comparison; English pronunciations vary. Unmatched /al/, vowels, voicing and Mandarin tone remain limitations.
claim.zh-Hans: banal ↔ 般 bān / 一般：Phonetic-Semantic Candidate；语义强度 moderate，整体置信度 Low；Historical Relation: Not claimed。语义依据是“一般”的普通／通常义，不主张单字“般”总有普通义。现代 banal 常含陈腐、无新意的贬义，“一般”未必如此。法语 /ba.nal/ 可与 bān 作局部 ban- 音近观察；英语有多种读法。未对应的 /al/、元音、清浊与汉语声调仍是限制。

claim.en: donner ↔ 捅: Weak Active Association / Original Author Association, not a primary mapping. French donner means give and descends from Latin donare. The supplied “捅钱 = 给钱” and reading tōng remain Original Author Usage Observation; standard Mandarin dictionaries give 捅 tǒng (poke/pierce, reveal, provoke), not a verified stable give sense. The targeted dictionary/dialect search did not establish that sense; this is a bounded evidence gap, not proof that no speaker uses it. Historical Relation: Not claimed. Donner is not a historical component of abandon.
claim.zh-Hans: donner ↔ 捅：Weak Active Association / Original Author Association，不作主要映射。法语 donner 意为给，源自拉丁语 donare。用户的“捅钱＝给钱”及 tōng 读法保留为 Original Author Usage Observation；标准普通话词典记“捅”tǒng（戳刺、揭露、招惹），没有核验出稳定的给予义。此次词典／方言检索未能证实该义，不等于证明无人这样使用。Historical Relation: Not claimed。donner 不是 abandon 的历史构词部分。

summary.en: Original Author Hypothesis: a.ban.don / a + ban + donner; ban = prohibit, donner = give, therefore prohibit giving = abandon. Independent evaluation: Rejected/Unsupported as historical segmentation. CNRTL regards a ban donner as improbable because that phrase is unattested; the cited doner a abandon examples are later (13th century). Preserve the observation without presenting it as etymology.
summary.zh-Hans: 原始作者假说：a.ban.don / a + ban + donner；ban＝禁止，donner＝给，因此禁止给＝放弃。独立核验：Rejected/Unsupported as historical segmentation（作为历史拆分被否定／缺乏支持）。CNRTL 认为 a ban donner 分析不可信，因为该短语无见证；所引 doner a abandon 例子较晚（13世纪）。保留观察，不作为词源。

relation_to_entry.en: Related lexical note only: English band “group” comes through Middle French bande and Old Occitan banda, associated with a Germanic sign/banner history; band “strip/binding” has a distinct history. French bande is a noun with strip and group senses, not simply the verb “bandage.” CNRTL notes uncertainty in the route of the group sense. Spelling alone does not merge band/bande with abandon. Possible deeper sign/command interactions mentioned by etymologists do not establish the author’s segmentation or independent experimental evidence.

testability.zh-Hans: 仅在有更早见证形式支持该拆分时重开历史分析；它的否定不决定其他候选状态。

claim.en: English ban ↔ 甭 béng: Phonetic-Semantic Candidate; semantic strength moderate; overall confidence Low; Historical Relation: Not claimed. The overlap is contextual DON’T / DO NOT / PROHIBIT. English ban often means formal prohibition; 甭 commonly means no need/do not and need not prohibit. English /bæn/ and béng show an author-observed labial onset and loose rhyme resemblance, not homophony: Pinyin b is unaspirated /p/, English b is /b/, final /n/ versus /ŋ/, vowels and tone differ.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 ban ↔ 甭 béng：Phonetic-Semantic Candidate；语义强度 moderate，整体置信度 Low；Historical Relation: Not claimed。交点限于语境中的 DON’T / DO NOT / PROHIBIT。ban 常表正式禁止，“甭”常表不用／不必／不要，不总是禁止。/bæn/ 与 béng 的双唇起音及宽泛韵部近似仅为作者观察，并非同音：拼音 b 为不送气 /p/，英语 b 为 /b/，韵尾 /n/ 与 /ŋ/、元音和声调有别。

counterexamples: Different lexical/grammatical scope; /n/ vs /ŋ/; voicing/vowels/tone differ.

testability.en: Evaluate semantics and phonetics independently with negative cases and randomized controls; deduplicate etymological families. Publication does not validate this relation.
testability.zh-Hans: 分别核验语义和声音，保留反例与随机对照，按词源家族去重；词条发表不验证该关系。

claim.en: banal ↔ 般 bān / 一般: Phonetic-Semantic Candidate; semantic strength moderate; overall confidence Low; Historical Relation: Not claimed. The semantic anchor is the word 一般 in its ordinary/common sense, not an assertion that isolated 般 always means ordinary. Modern banal often adds a negative sense of unoriginal or trite that 一般 need not carry. French /ba.nal/ permits a partial ban- versus bān comparison; English pronunciations vary. Unmatched /al/, vowels, voicing and Mandarin tone remain limitations.
claim.zh-Hans: banal ↔ 般 bān / 一般：Phonetic-Semantic Candidate；语义强度 moderate，整体置信度 Low；Historical Relation: Not claimed。语义依据是“一般”的普通／通常义，不主张单字“般”总有普通义。现代 banal 常含陈腐、无新意的贬义，“一般”未必如此。法语 /ba.nal/ 可与 bān 作局部 ban- 音近观察；英语有多种读法。未对应的 /al/、元音、清浊与汉语声调仍是限制。

counterexamples: banal often means trite; isolated 般 is not equivalent; partial phonetic match only.

testability.en: Evaluate semantics and phonetics independently with negative cases and randomized controls; deduplicate etymological families. Publication does not validate this relation.
testability.zh-Hans: 分别核验语义和声音，保留反例与随机对照，按词源家族去重；词条发表不验证该关系。

statement.en: Original Author Hypothesis: a.ban.don / a + ban + donner; ban = prohibit, donner = give, therefore prohibit giving = abandon. Independent evaluation: Rejected/Unsupported as historical segmentation. CNRTL regards a ban donner as improbable because that phrase is unattested; the cited doner a abandon examples are later (13th century). Preserve the observation without presenting it as etymology.
statement.zh-Hans: 原始作者假说：a.ban.don / a + ban + donner；ban＝禁止，donner＝给，因此禁止给＝放弃。独立核验：Rejected/Unsupported as historical segmentation（作为历史拆分被否定／缺乏支持）。CNRTL 认为 a ban donner 分析不可信，因为该短语无见证；所引 doner a abandon 例子较晚（13世纪）。保留观察，不作为词源。

proposition.en: Active Association: abandon ↔ 放到一旁 → 旁 páng. CONTROL / DISPOSAL → RELEASE → PUT ASIDE → LEAVE/GIVE UP is an author-proposed cognitive and memory bridge, not an attested chain of sound change or translation of 旁 as abandon. Historical Relation: Not claimed; Active Association Status: Author-proposed / Cognitive association.
proposition.zh-Hans: Active Association：abandon ↔ 放到一旁 → 旁 páng。CONTROL / DISPOSAL → RELEASE → PUT ASIDE → LEAVE/GIVE UP 是作者提出的认知与记忆桥梁，不是已证历史音变链，也不把单字“旁”当作 abandon 的标准译词。Historical Relation: Not claimed；Active Association Status: Author-proposed / Cognitive association。

evidence_boundary.en: The author’s put-aside image may be explored freely; it is neither historical nor experimental evidence. Earlier 甭/GIVE UP editorial mnemonic retained only in revision history.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 作者“放到一旁”的意象可自由展开，不作历史或实验依据。早先“甭／GIVE UP”编辑记忆法仅在修订档案中保留。

source.raw_note:
abandon，放弃。甭 beng。ban 与甭同音。

2026-09-07 作者补充全文（保留词义／拆分／拼写；仅去除界面 Search 与 HTML 格式）：
abandon，放弃。甭beng。ban与甭同音
英語
abandon [ə'bændən] v. 放弃 [<法语]
a.ban.don
abandonment [ə'bændənmənt] n. 抛弃 [<法语]
ban [bæn] v. 禁止 [<法语]
banal [banal] a. 一般的，平凡.般。可以对应般ban
band n. 一帮，一伙
法語
abandonner [abandonner] v. 抛弃
a.ban.don.ner
ban v. 禁止。可以用甭beng这个字代表。
donner v. 送。用捅tong字对应，给谁的意思，捅钱。
漢語
甭【beng】v. 用法语ban禁止对应，英语ban禁止对应。
旁【pang】n. 旁边的旁字变成使动的用法，放到一旁，抛弃。与法语ban禁止对应，英语ban禁止对应。这里给一个可能性而已。
捅【tong】v. 给的意思。与法语donner给字对应，与英语donate给予对应。
动【dong】v.
备注：为什么这里分开ban而不是band，因为这个词从法语来，法语里面没有band这个词，是bande包扎。法语中有ban禁止，interdict禁止。法语donner，给的意思。合起来就是禁止给=放弃。如果仅仅从英语角度也可以有这样的解释：a- [a] pref. 没有的意思，用罢ba字对应。band [band] n. 帮伙。不过仅仅是记忆方便这样说，因为这个词从法语而来最后还是从法语角度介绍为好。现在考虑abadon这个词

independent_evaluation.en: donner ↔ 捅: Weak Active Association / Original Author Association, not a primary mapping. French donner means give and descends from Latin donare. The supplied “捅钱 = 给钱” and reading tōng remain Original Author Usage Observation; standard Mandarin dictionaries give 捅 tǒng (poke/pierce, reveal, provoke), not a verified stable give sense. The targeted dictionary/dialect search did not establish that sense; this is a bounded evidence gap, not proof that no speaker uses it. Historical Relation: Not claimed. Donner is not a historical component of abandon.
independent_evaluation.zh-Hans: donner ↔ 捅：Weak Active Association / Original Author Association，不作主要映射。法语 donner 意为给，源自拉丁语 donare。用户的“捅钱＝给钱”及 tōng 读法保留为 Original Author Usage Observation；标准普通话词典记“捅”tǒng（戳刺、揭露、招惹），没有核验出稳定的给予义。此次词典／方言检索未能证实该义，不等于证明无人这样使用。Historical Relation: Not claimed。donner 不是 abandon 的历史构词部分。
